title: Juicy American Cheese Sandwich
description: A classic American cheese sandwich, made with rye bread, american cheese, and a hint of peppery flavor. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or lunch on the go.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Butter one side of each rye bread slice.
Place one slice, buttered side down, in the grill.
Top with a slice of american cheese, a few slices of onion, a few slices of tomato, a few leaves of lettuce, and a few slices of rye bread.
Place another slice of rye bread, buttered side up, on top of the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the sandwich over and cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the other side is also golden brown.
For a plant-based version, replace the american cheese with a plant-based alternative, such as vegan cheese or hummus.
For an extra-crispy crust, brush the bread with water before cooking.
To make nigiri-style sandwiches, shape the sandwiches into small rectangles and serve on a platter.
